releaseScope: 3.3.0 P2: the `standard` scenario now names its Skill instead of relying on the full-declaration fallback, and the pointable pool grows from 11 scenario cards to 22 by adopting the 11 role cards the consuming Agent already locks. Declaring a Skill does not deliver it — only the scenario's own selection does — so this widens what a scenario may ask for without widening any delivery.
